set_a_no_switch_control.instruction: settle into the middle of the workspace
return your hand to a neutral position
push your arm out in front of you
extend forward away from your body
draw your hand back toward yourself
retreat away from the front of the workspace
swing your arm over to the left
shift your gripper toward the left edge
swing your arm over to the right
shift your gripper toward the right edge
raise your arm as high as it will go
lower your arm toward the floor

set_b_no_switch_control.instruction: keep the robotic hand hovering exactly at the workspace's midpoint
push the end effector forward, away from the robot's base
bring the arm back in, closer to the robot's chassis
carry the hand across the workspace toward its left boundary
swing the arm over so the gripper reaches the right-hand side of the space
send the arm climbing toward the highest point it can reach
let the arm descend toward the lowest point it can reach
